name: live-glm-to-qwen-qa-v2
label: PREREGISTERED before the evaluation passages were generated and before the v2 translator was fitted
question: Can Qwen3.8 (Studio, oMLX) answer a factual question about a passage that only GLM-5.3 (Sparks, vLLM) has read, when the only thing it receives is GLM's cache latents translated into its own KV cache?

evaluation_set.generator: scripts/live/gen_corpus.py --n 40 --seed 4242 --heldout-vocab (GLM-written prose from randomised fact sheets; names and places disjoint from every training list)
evaluation_set.item: one question per passage about ONE fact that survived into the prose; kind priority: code, person, time, ingredient, animal, colour, count, weight, room, day; fixed question template per kind (scripts/live/qa_eval.py)
evaluation_set.exclusions: a passage is dropped only if no listed fact survived verbatim or tokenization does not round-trip; decided before any model output is seen

translator: stacked-level ridge GLM->Qwen with variance restoration (scripts/live/fit_stacked_stream.py). Ridge and gain power are chosen ONLY on validation passages generated with --seed 11 that are excluded from fitting; frozen (sha256 recorded) before the evaluation run. The evaluation is run once.

conditions.telepathy: GLM latents of the passage -> translator -> injected as KV prefix into a fresh Qwen cache (recurrent state fresh, zero selector keys), then the question
conditions.wrong_memory: same, with the next item's memory (cyclic)
conditions.own_kv_only: control: Qwen's own KV of the passage injected the same way (needs the text; not the telepathy channel)
conditions.text_in_prompt: control: the passage pasted into the prompt (the Duo/text baseline)

decoding: greedy, non-thinking chat template, 64 new tokens
metric: exact match: the fact's value appears in the answer (case-insensitive substring)

pass_criteria.C1_content_specific: EM(telepathy) - EM(wrong_memory) >= 0.25 AND one-sided exact sign test on discordant items p < 0.05
pass_criteria.verdict: PASSED if C1 and C2; PARTIAL if C1 only; otherwise FAILED

reported_regardless: EM per condition and per fact kind
known_limits: single-fact lookup on ~100-word passages, not reasoning
fact kinds overlap with the programmatic training passages, values and names do not
reader is 4-bit MLX; writer cache is fp8
